THE DIRECTIONS

You will talk to four people. Record what you would say to each one. You can record again as many times as you want. When all four are recorded, click Submit.

The first time you press record, your computer will ask to use your microphone. Click Allow.

THE SCENE

Your science team traveled back in time to Basra. You are testing an idea from an old book about animals. The idea is that ants that work together bring home more food. More food helps the whole nest stay alive. Each person on your team counted one number, and you need all four.

THE HISTORY

This trip is about al-Jahiz, a writer from Basra, Iraq. He lived about twelve hundred years ago. He wrote a big book about animals. He watched ants work together to keep food in their nest.
